pieces.description: Short, thick navy-blue hair with teal highlights forms a rounded, tousled cut with layered strands and a long, uneven fringe.
A plain white cotton jersey T-shirt has a crew neckline and a hip-length hem visible beneath the hoodie.
Olive-green woven cargo joggers have a loose, baggy full-length cut, large flap pockets on the outer thighs, gathered ankle cuffs, and no visible print.

A black fleece pullover hoodie has an oversized hip-length cut, long sleeves, a hood, ribbed cuffs and hem, a kangaroo pocket, and a red jagged lettering print above a large white-and-black chest graphic.
A pair of ankle-high leather sneakers combines navy-blue and white panels, red tongue and collar accents, white laces, cream midsoles, and purple outsole edges.
A small gray canvas crossbody bag has a rounded rectangular shape, dark piping, zippered compartments, and a wide charcoal strap crossing the chest to hold the pouch at the hip.
